Class PostController

java.lang.Object
arkheim.server.infrastructure.api.controllers.PostController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/posts") public class PostController extends Object
Controller for managing post creations, deletions, likes, and timelines.

  • Method Details

    • createPost

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<PostResponse> createPost(@RequestBody CreatePostRequest createPostRequest)
      Creates a new post and automatically processes any hashtags inside the post description. HTTP Method: POST Endpoint: /api/posts
      Parameters:
      createPostRequest - the payload containing post details (author ID, content, media URL, parent post ID)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing PostResponse of the created post

    • deletePost

      @DeleteMapping("/{postId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deletePost(@PathVariable UUID postId, @RequestParam UUID requesterId)
      Deletes a specific post by its UUID. HTTP Method: DELETE Endpoint: /api/posts/{postId}
      Parameters:
      postId - the UUID of the post to delete
      requesterId - the UUID of the user requesting deletion (ownership verification is checked)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with no content (HTTP 204)

    • toggleLike

      @PostMapping("/{postId}/like") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> toggleLike(@PathVariable UUID postId, @RequestParam UUID userId)
      Toggles a user's like status on a specific post (likes if not liked, otherwise unlikes). HTTP Method: POST Endpoint: /api/posts/{postId}/like
      Parameters:
      postId - the UUID of the post to like/unlike
      userId - the UUID of the user performing the action
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with HTTP 200 status

    • getUserTimeline

      @GetMapping("/timeline") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<PostResponse>> getUserTimeline(@RequestParam UUID requesterId)
      Retrieves a specific user's timeline (reposts and posts created by them). HTTP Method: GET Endpoint: /api/posts/timeline
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the UUID of the user viewing the timeline (for status context check)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing a list of PostResponse representing the user timeline
